part: Part A: Rayleigh-Benard convection-onset test (shallow-layer control + tube measurement)

spec: glass petri dish ~100mm diameter, or small flat glass baking dish; flat bottom is essential for uniform layer depth
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'glass petri dish 100mm' or use a kitchen glass baking dish

spec: 2-3 mm INTERNAL bore, clear rigid acrylic or glass, 100-200mm length. Rigid preferred over silicone (soft tubing sags and changes H). Buy a short assortment if unsure of bore.
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'clear rigid acrylic tube 3mm ID' or 'glass capillary tube 3mm bore'

spec: silicone plugs, epoxy, or hot glue to seal the tube bubble-free at both ends

part: Electric hot plate OR aquarium heater + metal plate
spec: any flat uniformly-heated surface. Uniformity matters MORE than precision - a hot spot creates a horizontal gradient that convects at any delta_T and invalidates the measurement.
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'small electric hot plate' or 'aquarium heater 100W' + a flat aluminium/steel plate

spec: inexpensive PID or thermostat controller to hold a stable low delta_T; a sous-vide circulator substitutes well if already owned
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'Inkbird temperature controller' or reuse a sous-vide circulator

spec: -50 to 300C, 2 thermocouple inputs, 0.1C resolution. Differential measurement with matched probes on one meter cancels most absolute error - this is why a dual-channel unit matters more than a high-accuracy single one.
thin-tip wire probes, K-type, matched pair (buy 2 identical)
example_supplier_or_search_term: usually bundled with the meter above; buy a matched spare pair

spec: to measure layer depth / tube bore precisely - this enters the Rayleigh number as H^3, so a 5% depth error is a 16% Ra error

part: Mica powder or aluminium flake tracer
spec: fine flake tracer that aligns with shear and makes convection cells DIRECTLY visible as a polygonal/roll pattern - far better onset signal than watching dye diffuse
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'mica powder fine cosmetic grade' or 'aluminium flake pigment'

spec: portable GFCI adapter if the workspace outlet is not already GFCI-protected
for timestamped video/photos of convection-cell onset
low-RPM (1-5 RPM) geared DC motor, for slow clinostat rotation
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'low RPM geared DC motor 1-5 RPM' (common in citizen-science clinostat/plant-biology builds)

spec: variable DC power supply or PWM controller for the motor above, 6-12V
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'PWM DC motor speed controller kit'

spec: clear tubing, 3-10mm ID, ~30cm length, for the settling-column mount on the clinostat
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'clear silicone tubing 6mm ID' or 'clear PVC tubing small diameter'

spec: basic bracket/hinge hardware to mount the tube at ~10 degrees off the motor's rotation axis, or 3D-printed bracket
example_supplier_or_search_term: hardware store fasteners, or a local makerspace 3D printer

spec: polystyrene or glass microspheres, ~5-10 um and ~100-200 um size classes, small vial each
aquarium-grade small peristaltic or gravity-fed drip system for a slow, controlled flow through the clinostat-mounted tube
example_supplier_or_search_term: search 'mini peristaltic pump 12V' or improvise a gravity-fed IV-drip-style reservoir

part: Part B subtotal (must-buy items only, additional to Part A)
